js: 'The Chat image tools against a real image row (chat-media-tools design §8.1): the live pane through the stages (loading the model, generating) with the preview frames and the step count, the picture replacing them with its card, then a second picture cancelled mid-way: Cancel says it restarts the model, its inline confirm says why, and the result says the container was stopped. One container start, two 512x512 pictures. Run: scripts/chat-media-drive.sh --live --webkit (it fills in the thread id and the helpers of scripts/drive/chat-media.js).'

(() => { window.__stages = []; window.__steps = []; setInterval(() => { const l = __cm.live(); if (!l) return; const w = l.querySelector('.media-stage-words')?.textContent || ''; if (w && __stages[__stages.length - 1] !== w) __stages.push(w); const s = (l.querySelector('.media-step')?.textContent || '').match(/Step (\d+) \/ (\d+)/); if (s && __steps[__steps.length - 1] !== s[1]) __steps.push(s[1]); }, 100); return 'sampling'; })()
__cm.send('Draw a lighthouse on a cliff at dusk.')

label: a preview frame shows while the picture is drawn
the picture replaces the live pane
the card gives the local row's facts
a picture being drawn says its cancel restarts the model

expect: document.querySelector('.media-confirm').textContent.includes('Cancel restarts image/z-image-turbo: it cannot stop mid-picture')
label: the confirm says plainly that cancelling restarts the image model
the cancelled call's result says so
the result says the container was stopped
